input.text: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.
sources: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.

input.text: Do not open an account until you have verified two forms of identification for each signer. When the branch manager approves, you can instead accept one form of identification plus a verified bank reference.
sources: Do not open an account until you have verified two forms of identification for each signer, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.

input.text: Staff resolve each complaint within 15 business days of receipt or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.
sources: Resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: A branch manager may waive up to $50 in fees for one account in a calendar year.
sources: The most a branch manager can waive for one account in a calendar year is $50.

input.text: Place a standard hold of 2 business days on deposited checks that don't qualify for next day availability.
sources: Place a standard hold of 2 business days on deposited checks that don't qualify for next-day availability.
